astrolabe_wiki_query.syntax:
Base keys: filters, formulas, properties, summaries, views.
View keys: type (table, cards, list, kanban, map), name, filters, order (the columns, a list of property ids), sort (a list of property and direction ASC or DESC), groupBy, limit, summaries (property id: summary name).
Summaries: Average, Min, Max, Sum, Range, Median, Stddev, Earliest, Latest, Checked, Unchecked, Empty, Filled, Unique; Filled counts rows with a value.
File methods: file.hasLink(), file.hasTag(), file.hasProperty(), file.inFolder(), file.linksOfType(), file.backlinksOfType().
